FX-TURBNOISE-033.says: Size 4, contrast 300, Overflow clip: in an 8-bit composition the same as FX-TURBNOISE-009, allow_hdr holding to 0..1 there too.

FX-TURBNOISE-034.says: Size 4, contrast 300, Overflow soft_clamp: the greys eased toward black and white, none reaching them.

FX-TURBNOISE-035.says: Size 4, contrast 300, Overflow wrap_back: the greys past white and black fold back, light bands inside the dark.

FX-TURBNOISE-036.says: Size 4, Rotation 90: FX-TURBNOISE-002's clouds turned a quarter clockwise round the card's middle.

FX-TURBNOISE-037.says: Size 4, Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 90 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-TURBNOISE-002, frame 4 FX-TURBNOISE-036.

FX-TURBNOISE-038.says: Size 4, Scale Width 200, Scale Height 50, Uniform Scaling on: the two scales left out, so it is FX-TURBNOISE-002.

FX-TURBNOISE-039.says: Size 4, Offset (6, -4), Perspective Offset on: the coarse clouds slide 6 right and 4 up, each finer octave half as far as the last.

FX-TURBNOISE-040.says: Size 4, Perspective Offset on with no offset: nothing slides, so it is FX-TURBNOISE-002 within the tolerance.

FX-TURBNOISE-041.says: Size 4, Sub Influence 100: every octave as strong as the first, busier fine detail.

FX-TURBNOISE-042.says: Size 4, Sub Influence 0: only the first octave counts, so it is FX-TURBNOISE-007 (complexity 1) within the tolerance.

FX-TURBNOISE-043.says: Size 4, Sub Scaling 70: each octave only a little finer than the last, softer clouds.

FX-TURBNOISE-044.says: Size 4, Sub Rotation 45: each finer octave turned an eighth more.

FX-TURBNOISE-045.says: Size 4, Sub Offset (5, 3): each finer octave slid further.

FX-TURBNOISE-046.says: Size 4, Center Subscale on: the octaves grow finer round the card's middle, not its corner.

FX-TURBNOISE-047.says: Size 4, dynamic on spline, Rotation 30, Offset (3, 2) with Perspective Offset, Sub Influence 70, Sub Scaling 60, Sub Rotation 20, Sub Offset (1, -2), Center Subscale on: everything together.

FX-TURBNOISE-048.says: Size 4, cloudy, Sub Influence 80: cloudy's 0.35 a step scaled to 0.56.

FX-TURBNOISE-049.says: Size 4, blending mode soft_light: the card's shading lifted and lowered gently by the clouds.

FX-TURBNOISE-050.says: Size 4, blending mode hard_light, opacity 70: as soft_light but harder.

FX-TURBNOISE-051.says: Size 4, blending mode darken: each channel the darker of the card and the clouds.

FX-TURBNOISE-052.says: Size 4, blending mode lighten: each channel the lighter.

FX-TURBNOISE-053.says: Size 4, blending mode difference: each channel how far apart; the black patch shows the clouds themselves.

FX-TURBNOISE-054.says: FX-TURBNOISE-036 moved three pixels right: turned round the drawing's own middle, so the turned clouds move with it.

FX-TURBNOISE-055.says: FX-TURBNOISE-002 with every D-647 setting written as added: FX-TURBNOISE-002 to the bit.

FX-TURBNOISE-056.says: Overflow "hdr", not one of the four. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-057.says: Sub Scaling 5, below 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-058.says: Sub Influence 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-059.says: Uniform Scaling "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TURBNOISE-060.says: Size 4, blending mode hue, opacity 60: the noise is grey, so the card is drained towards its own grey at its own lightness, 60 per cent of the way (the W3C's Hue, our basis).
